title: 戴尔供应链老手：零部件博弈多年，HPE的利润率压力怎么解？
speaker: Maribel Lopez

segments.en: You mentioned about the pressure we're seeing around the model space.
segments.zh: 你提到了模型领域面临的压力。

segments.en: What about the hardware space, right? Because I see a good story like Dell, raising their annual sales forecast, they talk about the AI server demand is strong, but then I pair that with what HPE was basically dealing
segments.zh: 那硬件领域呢？比如戴尔上调年度销售预期，称AI服务器需求强劲，但惠普却面临利润率担忧和零部件成本问题。

segments.en: with is margin concerns and component costs as well. How do you kind of sift through the hardware space in the moment?
segments.zh: 你如何梳理当前的硬件领域？

segments.en: I think one of the things you have to really look at is what is the supply chain expertise within a company?
segments.zh: 我认为关键要看公司的供应链专业能力。

segments.en: Dell has always been a supply chain expertise company. It has the ability to actually impact margins more so than a lot of other companies in the industry
segments.zh: 戴尔一直是供应链专家，比业内许多公司更能影响利润率。

segments.en: because it's really been playing the component game for a very, very long time and it knows how to do it well.
segments.zh: 因为它长期参与零部件博弈，深谙此道。

segments.en: So depending on what deals you cut at what point in time, you could have much better margins for this period of time and we all had the discussion about what happened
segments.zh: 所以根据交易时机和条款，这段时间利润率可能更好，我们都讨论过

segments.en: with memory and other things and how that impacted the market.
segments.zh: 内存等方面的情况及其对市场的影响。

segments.en: I certainly saw that happen in Intel last week with a discussion about where PC demand and other things were going, but I really do think the other thing
segments.zh: 上周英特尔也讨论了PC需求等走向，但我觉得另一件

segments.en: that is really been interesting is the concept of the execution of the AI factory.
segments.zh: 有趣的事是AI工厂的执行概念。

segments.en: How do we get hardware into organizations in the way that they can get it up and running quickly so that they can deliver value?
segments.zh: 如何将硬件引入企业，使其快速部署并创造价值？

segments.en: So if you're not going to do it in the cloud, you're building an AI factory on prem and Dell and Lenovo have been executing on that strategy quite well.
segments.zh: 如果不采用云端方案，而是在本地构建AI工厂，戴尔和联想在该战略上执行得相当出色。
